## CELL FACTS

Cell 木_偏财 (Wood carrying The Horizon). Persona The Horizon (偏财). Definition line: "Wide-ranging engagement, opportunity sensed at a distance". Keyword Reach, charge dynamic, poles catalyst Momentum / friction Scatter. Family function: Action. Cost dimension: opportunity sensed far off; the near things blur. Arena: horizon, wind, open road, far light, the next place. Classical portrait: wide-ranging engagement; opportunity sensed at a distance; windfall, generosity, the near things blur. Ruled domains: Opportunity, Ventures, Father. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 正财.
Element arena: Wood (trunk, branch, root, grain, growth, the forest). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Metal. structural_interaction seed: "Metal directing Wood broadly — precision ranging across living material".
- k2_overview: "Your Wood moves as the Horizon: growth that reaches for distant light. Opportunity, for you, is territory: new markets, new cities, branches extended where no one from home has grown. You expand naturally and prune reluctantly. Fortune arrives through the reaching. Roots decide how much of it you keep."
- k2_functional: "You grow toward opportunity steadily, extending reach every season without retreating."
- adj_chips: {"friction":["Scattered","Overgrown","Fickle"],"catalyst":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Opportunity":"Opportunities appear to you as open land: markets unplanted, niches unclaimed. You see fertile ground others call wilderness. Scout it, but check the soil before transplanting everything.","Ventures":"Your ventures grow in groves: several trunks sharing a root system of skills and contacts. Let each mature before seeding the next. Orchards fail from planting fever, not planting.","Father":"The father-thread runs green and rangy: reach, enterprise, restlessness, wherever a paternal figure stood. Where that reaching shaped you, keep it. Where it left no roots, plant them yourself."}

- Sibling cell 木_正财 catalyst row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Improving what you already own comes easier to you than chasing what you don’t, and it shows everywhere you’ve settled. Care, in your hands, behaves like an investment: whatever you maintain appreciates, and whatever needs chasing, you mostly no longer bother to chase."

Core element Metal, energy element Wood. Law: Metal tames Wood (金克木: the knife prunes the branch). Relative to the core the energy is the tamed, so Wood is this core's Action. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Metal core that shows Wood on the catalyst pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The catalyst pole of Wood as the Action is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels); tone by pole: compliment. value.text: Seeing an opening where there was nothing is simply how you look. You have more drive than you have Wood to spend it on, so you feel the far chance more than the one already in your hand. Let the near thing have you for an hour, since the far one keeps.

value_b.text: You notice the next chance long before it is obvious, and you trust that noticing. Wood is what you have least of for the force behind it, so you look at what is far ahead of what is close. Spend one evening on what is close, and the far will keep.

value.text: Your generosity is pointing out the next opening to whoever is near. Since the far chance feels more alive to you, you hand the near one off rather than finish it, and you leave the rest with a partner. value.text: Starting comes easily to you, long before most people have finished deciding. Moving is how you know you are alive, so you begin and learn rather than wait until you are sure. Begin as freely as you do, and let one thing run long enough to teach you the ending.

value_b.text: You begin things the way other people make plans, early and without much fuss. Waiting feels like losing time you will never get back, which is why you take a quick start ahead of a sure one every time. Let the quick start be yours and the slow middle be yours as well.

value.text: Whenever something new opens, you are halfway in before asking what it will take. Beginning feels like freedom and waiting feels like a cage, so you choose the beginning ahead of the rest you were owed. value.text: Giving comes more naturally to you than keeping, with money the clearest case. Since an open hand keeps the world feeling wide, you share a lucky month rather than put it away. Give the way you always have and hold one part back, because what you keep is what the giving stands on.

value_b.text: You give before you count, and you rarely regret it in the moment. Holding back feels like holding your breath, which is why what you have goes to whoever needs it ahead of whatever you planned. Keep giving, and give one month a plan too, because a plan is how the giving lasts.

value.text: An open hand is your first answer to most things, and savings pay for it. Since being generous feels more like you than being careful, you send the surplus out ahead of putting any aside. Let one part of a good month be yours, because a thin month comes whether you planned or not.

value.text: Whenever someone close to you is short, you cover it before being asked. Since giving keeps you free in a way being owed never would, you hand things over rather than build anything shared with them. Build one thing with someone instead of handing it over, because a gift is what your freedom costs them.
